mission_10: This capstone mission combines all feature engineering techniques into a complete pipeline. You will transform a raw customer dataset into a rich feature matrix suitable for machine learning. The pipeline includes categorical encoding (one-hot and label), interaction features, binning, frequency encoding, polynomial expansion, and scaling. Building end-to-end feature engineering pipelines is a critical skill that separates effective data scientists from beginners. Each step in the pipeline contributes to creating features that capture the underlying patterns in your data.
